obligations.required: Independent raw minute price/volume vintage and dated adjustment/ISIN chain. A rounded adjusted price cannot be inverted exactly using a share ratio.
Contemporaneous membership/action/calendar publication times and causal outage handling.
Dated account tariff/contract-note reconciliation; present v2 taxes are a reference estimate.
Timestamped executable spread/depth, latency and participation/fill calibration. OHLCV and public last trade do not prove executable liquidity or 5bps slippage.
